title: Connect Meta
excerpt: Connect Meta catalog access for FeedOps product feed workflows.
author: FeedOps
content:
Connect Meta when your product catalog needs to sync with Meta commerce surfaces.

Before connecting

  • Confirm you can access the right Meta Business account.
  • Check that you have catalog management permissions.
  • Make sure the catalog is connected to the correct business assets.

Steps

  • Open FeedOps Connections.
  • Choose Meta.
  • Approve the requested business and catalog permissions.
  • Select the catalog FeedOps should manage.
